name: plan-relay-workspace
description: The npm workspaces of plan-relay: the host-free core packages and the VS Code extension.

scripts.format: prettier --write hosts/vscode/src hosts/vscode/media "hosts/vscode/*.mjs" core/reader core/panel core/i18n "*.mjs" "*.mts"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check hosts/vscode/src hosts/vscode/media "hosts/vscode/*.mjs" core/reader core/panel core/i18n "*.mjs" "*.mts"
